crossRefs.note: He came to his father, and said, “My father?” He said, “Here I am. Who are you, my son?”

translations.web: He came to his father, and said, “My father?” He said, “Here I am. Who are you, my son?”
translations.bsb: So Jacob went to his father and said, “My father.” “Here I am!” he answered. “Which one are you, my son?”
translations.kjv: And he came unto his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here am I; who art thou, my son?
translations.asv: And he came unto his father, and said, My father. And he said, Here am I. Who art thou, my son?
